summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Stinson Beach, a census-designated place in Marin County, California, on the US west coast. It gives the community's location relative to Bolinas, its elevation, and its 2010 census population.
one_line: Stinson Beach is a census-designated place in Marin County, California, with a 2010 population of 632.
key_facts: Stinson Beach is a census-designated place in Marin County, California.
Stinson Beach is located on the west coast of the United States.
Stinson Beach is located east-southeast of Bolinas.
Stinson Beach is at an elevation of 26 feet (8 m).
The population of the Stinson Beach CDP was 632 at the 2010 census.
